name: John F. Higgins, IV
tagline: Top rated Bankruptcy attorney in Houston, Texas
about: John F. Higgins, IV is an attorney providing legal services covering Bankruptcy: Business and Business Litigation.

John Higgins, IV, who practices law in Houston, Texas, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2003 - 2026. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, he studied at University of Houston Law Center. He graduated in 1983. After passing the bar exam, he was admitted to legal practice in 1983.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
